notes: V2.2 with the sector-port grain and a commanded run-valve shutdown. Grain: centre port 14.14 mm + 4 sector ports, ring/spoke webs 17.53 mm, wall web 8.76 mm. Balanced webs (every web burns out at the same depth), centre and sector ports at equal hydraulic diameter, and the same 1241 mm^2 port area as the five 17.78 mm round ports it replaces -- so initial oxidiser flux is unchanged, but burning surface is 26% higher and O/F is lower. The five round ports on their best circle leave only a 7.00 mm wall web; this layout gives 8.76 mm. Injector: the 40 x 1.20 mm plate from V2.2_Pc25bar_40x1.20mm.json is kept -- re-sizing to 25 bar on this grain gives 39-44 holes across the candidate fits, so the plate does not need to change. Run valve closes at 3.8 s, about 0.25 s before the liquid runs out (4.05 s), leaving ~1.05 kg in the tank (0.22 kg of it liquid). That removes the vapour tail, which burns web for little impulse. Vent the tank remotely after the fire. Web check with the valve closing at 3.8 s -- HRAP default (placeholder): 6.33 of 8.76 mm web (72%), 7890 N.s, Pc peak 25.4 bar, mean O/F 7.50; SP7 a (likely N2O): 7.08 of 8.76 mm web (81%), 8058 N.s, Pc peak 25.5 bar, mean O/F 6.54; SP7 b (likely N2O): 6.16 of 8.76 mm web (70%), 7854 N.s, Pc peak 24.2 bar, mean O/F 7.75; Liu 2020 N2O (metallised): 3.77 of 8.76 mm web (43%), 7206 N.s, Pc peak 22.8 bar, mean O/F 13.85; SP1A (probably GOX): 8.76 of 8.76 mm web (100%), BURNS THROUGH at 2.17 s; FR5560 (unconfirmed): 8.76 of 8.76 mm web (100%), BURNS THROUGH at 1.68 s. SP1A and FR5560 burn through in ~2 s whatever the valve does; both are probably not N2O data (see preset provenance). Regression coefficients are literature values, not measured on this motor: weigh the grain before and after the first fire.
